arguments.script: var m=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tilemap>();var tc=m.GetComponent<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.TilemapCollider2D>();var co=m.GetComponent<UnityEngine.CompositeCollider2D>();m.RefreshAllTiles();tc.ProcessTilemapChanges();co.GenerateGeometry();return "cells="+m.GetUsedTilesCount()+" type="+m.GetColliderType(m.cellBounds.min)+" tc="+tc.shapeCount+" paths="+co.pathCount+" bounds="+co.bounds+" operation="+tc.compositeOperation+" rb="+co.attachedRigidbody.simulated+" enabled="+tc.enabled+" scale="+UnityEngine.Time.timeScale;
